title: Research Areas
intro: My work is organized around a set of connected research lines rather than a single method. The common thread is a preference for interpretable models, careful validation, reproducible analysis, and systems that keep scientific assumptions visible to the researcher.

cards.title: EEG and neural time-series
cards.text: Analysis of sensor-level neural signals, residual prediction, and brain-behaviour relationships in human timing and cognitive variability.

cards.title: Temporal cognition and human time reproduction
cards.text: Research on systematic bias in time reproduction, contextual effects, recent-trial influences, and computational accounts of temporal estimation.

cards.title: Bayesian and state-space modelling
cards.text: Interpretable behavioural models emphasizing central tendency, multiplicative variability, predictive diagnostics, and explicit model misspecification.

cards.title: ABCD developmental neuroimaging
cards.text: An ongoing research line using ABCD data to study adolescent brain maturation, resting-state connectivity, and dimensional autism/ADHD trait co-occurrence without disclosing unpublished analyses.

cards.title: Neurotechnology and scientific systems
cards.text: Design of privacy-aware and reproducible systems for neural analysis, modelling, simulation, multimodal inference, and research translation.

cards.title: Evidence systems and scientific decision support
cards.text: Structured evidence-review work focused on separating claims, sources, study design, outcome relevance, risk of bias, and support direction.
